c449318d3 [bugfix] avoid "shutdown in progress" error messages during shutdown. remove shutdown hook.

f94651041 [bugfix] provide better error message if jetty could not bind to the configured port.
90aa299b3 [refactor] moved jetty related code to org.exist.jetty

This confirms it: `src/org/exist/system.properties` has no `exist.home` key, so `SystemProperties.getInstance().getSystemProperty("exist.home", "unknown")` always returns `"unknown"`. That's exactly the bug the fix commit addresses by reverting to `System.getProperty("exist.home", ...)`.

Checking `SystemProperties.getInstance()` implementation confirms it just loads this same properties file.

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** I started from the fix commit,

which changes the "eXist Home" log line back from `SystemProperties.getInstance().getSystemProperty("exist.home", "unknown")` to `System.getProperty("exist.home", "unknown")`, and moves it earlier in the log block

.getInstance()`.

**(2) The introducing change:** Commit `3dc5041e2` ("Ensure access to org/exist/system.properties is consistent...") refactored the version
/build logging to route through a new `SystemProperties.getInstance().getSystemProperty(...)` helper backed by the resource file `src/org/exist/system.properties`. In doing so it
incorrectly swept the `exist.home` line into the same pattern, changing it from `System.getProperty("exist.home")` (a real JVM system property, set externally at startup) to `System

Properties.getInstance().getSystemProperty("exist.home", "unknown")`, which reads from the bundled properties resource file instead.

**(3) Supporting evidence:** 
- `src/org/exist/system.properties` (

checked at HEAD) only contains `vendor`, `vendor-url`, `product-name`, `product-version`, `product-semver`, `product-build`, `git-commit` — no `exist.home` key, confirming the lookup always falls back to `

"unknown"`.
- `SystemProperties.java`'s `getSystemProperty` method loads exactly that resource file via classloader, with no other source.
- The bug-fix commit's diff is a direct, minimal revert of this specific part of `3dc5041e2`'s change (restoring `System.getProperty("exist.home",

...)`), which is strong direct evidence this is the introducing commit.

I'm highly confident in this identification — the fix is essentially a targ
eted revert of the exact line changed in `3dc5041e2`, with no other candidate commits touching this line in between.
